answer: Because the timing is recorded against the wharf challenge, the saffron audit can replay the cedar history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm hence has to pad 110 submissions and hold every identity open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which pays the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. A farm of 2276 identities would post 3904 proofs and burn roughly 48 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
